This plot is small and has been part of my home for many years, growing enset and some fruit trees. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it because it is too costly and these plants have always grown with the manure and compost from my animals. My family and I will tend to it ourselves for about three weeks this season, but we cannot afford to hire outside workers.
